description: Weak, mixed left-side shape detector. Fires mostly when column 0 is empty or holds one stone, column 1 holds 2-3 stones, column 3 is not at height 3-4, and the bottom-left cols 1-2 form a checker: my stones at (row1,col1) and (row2,col2), theirs at (row1,col2) and (row2,col1). Early-game variant: their stones at bottom of cols 1-2 with mine at col 4 bottom and col 3 empty. Filling column 0 switches it off.
effect: Very small: forcing it high or off changes move probabilities by at most ~0.1; mostly lowers column 3 by a few points and raises column 1 (or 0/2) slightly.
notes: Hypotheses: checker motif in cols 1-2 (F1 0.15-0.19), their open anti-diagonal toward (3,0) (0.15), skyline heights + motif (0.255-0.257 best, AUROC 0.64, sim share 0.07), centre-well add-on (0.24). Minimal pairs: board-based, colour- and left-side-specific; filling col 0 or raising col 3 to height 3 kills it; their (1,3)/(1,4) stones also kill it in one test (unexplained). Synthesis reaches 12.2 vs dev max 7.4. Possibly a random direction or mixture; no clean concept.
